entity.summary: Kazakhstan-based centralized digital-asset exchange providing spot trading, instant exchange, P2P services, custody, and fiat funding through local banking rails.
entity.notes: The current first-party platform presents live account registration, spot trading, instant exchange, wallet, and P2P services. AFSA's current public register lists ATAIX Eurasia Ltd. under licence AFSA-A-LA-2025-0022 as active for Operating a Digital Asset Trading Facility, custody, and principal/agent dealing in digital assets. No exact platform launch date is inferred from the current full-authorisation date.

evidence.title: ATAIX Eurasia licensed crypto exchange
evidence.notes: Current first-party site presents active crypto purchase, exchange, wallet, trading, API, and local banking functions and identifies ATAIX Eurasia Ltd. as the operator.

evidence.title: ATAIX Eurasia Ltd. AFSA licence entry
evidence.notes: Official AFSA public register lists licence AFSA-A-LA-2025-0022 as active and authorises ATAIX Eurasia Ltd. to operate a Digital Asset Trading Facility and provide related regulated digital-asset services.
